category: government finance data API (debt, revenue, spending, interest rates, exchange rates)

free_tier.stated: Open API with no account and no token; no request rate or quota is stated; data free without restriction, in JSON, CSV or XML
free_tier.notes: Base https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service; fields, filter, sort, format and page[number] and page[size] parameters apply. A keyless debt-to-the-penny call answered HTTP 200.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the documentation page

egress.terms: not metered; no quota is stated

interface_detail: GET https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service/v2/accounting/od/debt_to_penny with fields, filter, sort, format and paging parameters, no key
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; every dataset also downloads as a file from the website
chaining: Keyless US federal debt, rates and exchange-rate tables; they pair with FRED series and the BLS data.
limits_note: Bulk path: every dataset is available as a machine-readable file download on the website.
binding_note: No request count or rate is published.

identity_cost.detail: The API is open and needs no user account or registration for a token; a keyless call answered HTTP 200.

reliability_note: No limit is published; a shared government service can throttle heavy callers.
confidence_note: Access terms are read from the vendor pages and a keyless call answered 200; no rate was measured.

evidence.proved: the API needs no account or token registration
evidence.quote: Our API is open, meaning that it does not require a user account or registration for a token.

evidence.proved: the data is free without restriction
evidence.quote: The data is offered free, without restriction, and available to copy, adapt, redistribute
The `page[number]=` and `page[size]=` parameters both accept integers.

evidence.proved: every dataset downloads in machine-readable formats
evidence.quote: All of our datasets are available for download in multiple machine-readable formats

notes: Keyless with no stated rate. Bulk path: file downloads per dataset.

extras.bulk_path: file downloads of every dataset on the website
